response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts
